The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. Technical Competency The bidder shall possess the necessary technical expertise, tools, equipment, a nd qualified technicians to carry out AC installation and dismantling work safely and professionally. 3. Police Verification and Security Clearance The bidder shall be responsible for arranging police verification and obtaining th e necessary security clearances for all technicians deployed in the designated h igh-security area before commencement of work. 4. installation work. 5. Installation and Dismantling Responsibility The bidder shall be responsible for the safe dismantling and removal of existing split AC units and the installation of new units without damaging the existing bui lding structure, walls, ceilings, electrical installations, or other infrastructure. An y damage caused shall be rectified by the bidder at their own cost. 6. Availability of Skilled Technicians The bidder shall ensure the availability of adequately trained and technically co mpetent personnel for timely completion of the work. 7. Statutory and Procurement Compliance The bidder shall comply with all applicable statutory requirements and the eligibility conditions expressly specified in the GeM bid. All supporting documen ts submitted shall be genuine and verifiable. 8.Financial Standing The bidder shall submit a declaration, duly signed by the authorized signatory, s tating that the firm/company has not been blacklisted or debarred by the comp etent authority as on the date of submission of the bid. The bidder shall declare that the firm/company is not under liquidation, court re ceivership, or similar proceedings and is not bankrupt. The above declarations shall be dated and signed by the authorized signatory a nd submitted along with the bid Makes: Approved Makes of ADG(P) Chennai are only accepted. . 4.
